Thanks again for committing to a hands-on POC with Redwood. To make the most of the session, proposed agenda below (45–60m):

- 20m: Prompt review & structured output test (we'll run your sample prompts)
- 15m: Router/latency check + canary load test (10 concurrent sessions)
- 10m: Next steps (data requirements, access, timeline)

Attachments: POC_agenda_v2.pdf, sample_prompts.json — feel free to drop any additional prompts you want included.

Slot options (PT):
- Tue 2026-11-17 09:00–10:00
- Tue 2026-11-17 14:00–15:00
- Wed 2026-11-18 11:00–12:00

If none of these work, propose two windows that do and I'll coordinate. I’m looping in Dylan (solutions) who will run the load test and Soojin (infra) for the routing checks.

Zoom link will be provided once we lock a time.

Thanks,
